name: Superhero
definition: A comic-book character recorded in this universe, identified by a superhero_name codename and optionally a real full_name, carrying biographical facets (gender, race, alignment, publisher, eye/skin colour, height, weight) plus rated attributes and superpowers.
scope: The central entity of the database; every other fact is ultimately about a superhero.

name: Superhero Name
definition: The codename that labels a superhero, e.g. '3-D Man', 'Copycat', 'Abomination'. This is the label a question uses when it says 'which superhero' or 'the superheroes'.
scope: Identifying label column of the superhero table.

name: Full Name
definition: The real-world personal name recorded for a superhero, e.g. 'Charles Chandler' for 3-D Man, 'Emil Blonsky' for Abomination. Distinct from superhero_name.
scope: Secondary identifying label; frequently not recorded.

name: Superhero Identifier
definition: The numeric primary key that identifies a superhero row, e.g. hero ID 1 is 3-D Man.
scope: Primary key of the superhero table.

name: Hero Reference
definition: The superhero identifier as carried by the link tables that attach attributes and superpowers to a superhero.
scope: Foreign-key usage of the superhero identifier in rating and power link rows.

name: Superpower
definition: A named ability that a superhero may possess, e.g. 'Super Strength', 'Flight'. A superhero may possess several superpowers and a superpower may belong to many superheroes.
scope: Capability dimension, attached to superheroes through a many-to-many link.

name: Super Attribute
definition: One of the six named capability dimensions on which superheroes are rated: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power, Combat.
scope: Rating dimension; each superhero has at most one rating per attribute.

name: Super Attribute Rating
definition: A single recorded rating of one superhero on one super attribute; it links a superhero to an attribute and carries the numeric attribute_value.
scope: Row-level concept grounded in the attribute-rating link table.

name: Attribute Value
definition: The numeric score a superhero receives on a super attribute. Higher means more capable; the observed scale runs from 5 to 100, with Intelligence starting at 35.
scope: Interpreted only together with a super attribute and a superhero.

name: Gender
definition: The recorded gender category of a superhero: Male, Female, or N/A.
scope: Categorical descriptor of a superhero.

name: Alignment
definition: The moral alignment of a superhero: Good, Bad, Neutral, or N/A. 'Villain' corresponds to Bad and 'hero' to Good.
scope: Categorical descriptor of a superhero.

name: Publisher
definition: The publishing imprint or franchise that owns a superhero, e.g. 'Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics', 'Dark Horse Comics', 'Star Trek'.
scope: Categorical descriptor linking a superhero to a publishing entity.

name: Publisher Identifier
definition: The numeric primary key of a publisher record, e.g. Star Trek has publisher ID 20.
scope: Primary key of the publisher table.

name: Race
definition: The species or racial origin recorded for a superhero, e.g. Human, Mutant, Symbiote.
scope: Categorical descriptor of a superhero.

name: Colour
definition: The shared colour vocabulary used for superhero physical features. It includes the literal category 'No Colour', used when a feature is recorded as absent or colourless rather than unknown.
scope: Shared vocabulary behind eye colour, hair colour and skin colour references.

name: Skin Colour
definition: The colour recorded for a superhero's skin; a superhero described as 'green-skinned' has skin colour Green.
scope: Physical descriptor of a superhero.

name: Eye Colour
definition: The colour recorded for a superhero's eyes; 'no eye colour' corresponds to the recorded colour value 'No Colour'.
scope: Physical descriptor of a superhero.

name: Height
definition: The recorded height of a superhero, expressed in centimetres.
scope: Physical measurement of a superhero; used for thresholds such as 'over 200cm' or ranges such as 170 to 190.

name: Weight
definition: The recorded weight of a superhero, expressed in kilograms.
scope: Physical measurement of a superhero; used for averages and comparisons.

name: Superhero Count
definition: The number of distinct superheroes matching a stated condition or belonging to a stated group.
scope: Aggregate metric; counts superheroes, not ratings or powers.

name: Maximum Attribute Value
definition: The largest attribute_value observed for a named super attribute within the superheroes in scope; used for phrasing such as 'most durability', 'highest strength', or 'the strongest'.
scope: Derived metric, valid only for one named super attribute at a time.

name: Minimum Attribute Value
definition: The smallest attribute_value observed for a named super attribute within the superheroes in scope; used for phrasing such as 'the slowest superhero'.
scope: Derived metric, valid only for one named super attribute at a time.

name: Average Weight
definition: The mean weight in kilograms across the superheroes in scope; used for averages and for percentage-of-average thresholds.
scope: Derived metric over a stated population of superheroes.

name: Gender Ratio
definition: The quotient between the number of male superheroes and the number of female superheroes in scope.
scope: Derived metric over superhero counts grouped by gender.
